testsuite.name: com.tiandili.calendar.platform.reminder.AndroidAlarmGatewayTest

testcase.name: schedule moves a missed trigger to the current instant
cancel removes the deterministic pending intent for a job
cancelling a reminder also removes its posted notification
schedule falls back to a window alarm when exact capability is unavailable
schedule uses an exact idle alarm when capability is available
